priorityList: Cast Primal Wrath with 5 Combo Points if Rip is not active, is within its Pandemic timer, or if the Rip snapshot can be strengthened with Tiger's Fury.
Cast Ferocious Bite / Ravage with 5 Combo Points (ensuring Bleeds are applied) or with an Apex Predator's Craving proc.
Cast Tiger's Fury on cooldown, aiming to be 70 or more Energy below your cap.
Cast Berserk on cooldown and sync with Tiger's Fury.
Cast Convoke the Spirits with Tiger's Fury active, during Berserk, before Tiger's Fury expires, and with as few Combo Points as possible.
Cast Swipe to generate Combo Points.
Berserk and Convoke the Spirits with Tiger's Fury, these should be synced.
